datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Malawi administrative units on a monthly basis (February, June, October 2016). The data represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity phases under different scenarios, spatially distributed as geographic features with classification values and metadata.
